t: Each song row's play button is now a camouflage cap on the left edge, with a pattern of its own
Water drops on the Lakehorse pages now catch the light like drops on a screen, with colour fringes at the edges
The water on the player is now drawn as fine lines that part around the ship
The site is now called DIYFY, on every band's pages
Jupiter Gold: fires are now flat weather-map style flame icons, and This Is War has a checkbox to play the instrumental mix
Swim game: the bong near the treasure chest no longer sits against the wreck, so it fires reliably
The striped edge of every song row is now a play and pause button
The swim game's first-bowl fish no longer says everything is talking at once
New look for Lakehorse: dazzle camouflage, wet textures, and a spaceship riding the waveform
Retro-futurist type, and plain hull-style icons in place of the emoji
Jupiter Gold has a This Is War version, with its own door on the Players page
What's new log rows now open the song at the comment
The comment delete button now shows on touch screens
Music and Art renamed, and Jupiter Gold gets a back link to Players
Visualizer FX joins the Image tools, and every tool has an offline copy button
